text: Rather than rescue the failed sectors, we discarded them. The strict model keeps one object, a small, axis-carrying cosmic vorticity, on an expanding universe. It begins with a Kerr-parent black hole, an inheritance knob from 0 to 1, and 10 numbered assumptions, A0 through A9. No rotating global frame, centrifugal dark energy, or unsupported metric correction returns through the backdoor. Unknown bounce transfer stays named, not hidden.
